title: DockScope 1.0.0
highlights: Advanced Docker diagnostics for builds, containers, ports, volumes and dependency topology.
Operation Task Center with guarded long-running operations and persistent SQLite history.
Diagnostics Bundle Export with redaction and bounded support data.
Storage Trends and customizable operational Dashboard.
Target-based Smart Cleanup Planning with persistent Volume exclusion.
Guarded Container File Browser with browse, text view, download, upload and audited writes.
security: Renderer remains sandboxed with nodeIntegration disabled and contextIsolation enabled.
Privileged Docker, filesystem, database and update operations stay in Electron Main.
Critical destructive operations continue to require explicit confirmation.
